title: City Park concerts in white uniforms
summary: A photo of the big band in City Park shows summer concerts in white seersucker uniforms, dated around 1937-38.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
